svg.title: A valve-release decision explained
svg.desc: Illustrative valve records connect to a measurement, source and acceptance rule; evidence and policy checks support an accountable decision rather than automatic approval. A proposed valve-release example shows how heterogeneous records become decision-relevant evidence. The graph links the subject, measurement, source and applicable rule. Verification and policy checks determine whether the evidence may support the task; AI explains the accepted facts, while the responsible participant controls the operation. A valid signature does not establish truth. Missing evidence can require HOLD. This is an illustrative workflow, not a validated safety case or a reported industrial deployment.
